_about: Ep01 study scenarios. Each one is an invented, generic business-writing task with no real organisation or person. 'facts' make up the specific brief. 'vague_sentence' is the input for Experiment B; it contains stock phrases on purpose. Briefs (task + facts) deliberately avoid stock phrases so the models aren't primed. Pilot scenarios (P*) are used only to test the procedure and estimate variance. They are excluded from the main analysis.

scenarios.task: a short email to my team about a new training programme
facts: three 90-minute sessions on 4, 11 and 18 November
it covers the new expenses system
filing a claim currently takes about 40 minutes and the aim is under 10
sign up on the intranet page by 1 November
questions to Priya
scenarios.vague_sentence: We need to heighten engagement with the training programme.

scenarios.task: a project status update for the steering group
facts: data migration is 70% complete
two-week delay because the supplier changed its file formats
new go-live date is 3 March
requesting £12,000 extra
decision needed on whether to drop the reporting module from phase one
scenarios.vague_sentence: The project is broadly on track, with some challenges we are working through.

scenarios.task: a message to my team announcing a change to how the team is organised
facts: the 14-person team splits into two groups, onboarding and retention, from 1 February
Sam leads onboarding and Ade leads retention
no roles are being cut
one-to-ones with everyone next week
scenarios.vague_sentence: We are restructuring to better align with our strategic priorities.

scenarios.task: a one-paragraph summary for a quarterly business review slide
facts: revenue was £2.1m against a £2.4m target
the shortfall is mostly two delayed contracts, now signed for January
customer churn fell from 6% to 4%
asking for approval to hire two support staff
scenarios.vague_sentence: Q3 was a quarter of mixed performance with strong foundations for growth.

facts: Thursday 12:30 to 13:15 in Room 4B and online
topic: how the new booking tool handles recurring meetings
20 places
sandwiches provided
book through the events calendar
scenarios.vague_sentence: Join us for an exciting session to unlock the potential of our new tools.

hybrid, two days a week in Leeds
main task is building weekly capacity reports in Excel and Power BI
closing date 15 December

existing annual subscribers are unaffected until renewal

scenarios.task: a note to my manager requesting budget
facts: requesting £4,500 for a usability study
8 user interviews in January
the last redesign increased support tickets by 25%
the results will decide whether we change the checkout flow
scenarios.vague_sentence: I'd like to request investment to optimise the customer experience.

still open: who pays for pallet returns

scenarios.task: an internal announcement about a new IT helpdesk system

urgent issues still go by phone on extension 4400
the old support inbox closes on 28 February

scenarios.task: a summary of a staff survey for the leadership team

71% would recommend working here, down from 78%

facts: the team cut average invoice processing time from 9 days to 3 days over six months

exceptions are agreed with HR

the policy will be reviewed in September

scenarios.task: an email to a client apologising for a delay

scenarios.task: a newsletter item about a charity fundraiser
